reason: This plugin is best classified as a navigation/interaction enhancement for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: it adds a Chat/Work session-mode toggle and a managed Chat workspace surfaced in the sidebar so users can separate non-project chat from project work sessions. Evidence shows it does not add new model behavior or external integrations; its primary action is organizing session presentation and navigation by registering modes, deriving mode from workspace membership, and applying local workspace/preset housekeeping in the harness profile.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的会话界面增强，提供 Chat/Work 切换入口并在侧边栏统一管理非项目聊天会话，便于在聊天与项目工作流间切换。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Chat/Work session-mode toggle in DeepSeek Harness and keeps non-project chat sessions grouped under a dedicated Chat workspace in the sidebar for easier switching between chat and project work.

capabilities: registers custom session modes and exposes a Chat/Work mode switch in the web conversation UI
creates and maintains a managed Chat workspace entry under the harness sessions location
pins/reorders the Chat workspace position in the sidebar
derives mode from the active conversation’s workspace location and handles navigation behavior
performs local legacy preset cleanup when recognized files match the plugin’s shipped preset content
